thread.title: Statewide recount for Public Service Commission District 3 to begin June 10 in Glynn County
thread.title_full: Statewide recount for Public Service Commission District 3 to begin June 10 in Glynn County

author: Peach Tree Times
title: Statewide recount for Public Service Commission District 3 to begin June 10 in Glynn County
text:
A recount of votes cast in the May 19, 2026, Republican General Primary Election for the Public Service Commission District 3 race will begin on June 10 at the Glynn County Board of Elections, located at 1709 Gloucester St. Logic and Accuracy testing is scheduled for June 10. Recounting will proceed daily on business days from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM through June 26 or until completion. Results of the recount will be posted on the county website and with the Secretary of State once complete.
The announcement was made as part of official election procedures following the close contest in District 3. The recount process aims to ensure accuracy and transparency in reporting final results.
Glynn County has seen changes in its community over recent years, including an increase in school enrollment by 2.2% during the 2022-23 school year, with a total student body of 14,196 students, according to the Georgia Department of Education. White students represented the largest ethnic group at local schools at 44%, followed by Black students at 33%, Hispanic students at 16%, and multiracial students making up about five percent.
The results from this recount are expected to clarify any outstanding questions regarding vote totals for this closely watched commission seat.
